decls.statement: theorem two_add_sigmaBar_eq {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : 2 + (pol hp0 hp1).sigmaBar (hitExp p) = (5 - 2 * p) / (1 - p)
decls.doc: `2 + σ̄ = (5−2p)/(1−p)`, the expected length of one loop-closed excursion.

decls.name: lam_src_eq_inv_two_add_sigmaBar
decls.statement: theorem lam_src_eq_inv_two_add_sigmaBar {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : lam p 0 = 1 / (2 + (pol hp0 hp1).sigmaBar (hitExp p))
decls.doc: **`prop:morozov_rate`*(1)* at `s₀`, on this graph**: `λ(s₀) = 1/(2+σ̄)`.

decls.name: minOver_visits_eq
decls.statement: theorem minOver_visits_eq {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : minOver cyc (visits cyc (green p)) = 1
decls.doc: `N ≡ 1/(1−p)` on the cycle and `N(s₀) = N(s_f) = 1`, so `min_x N(x) = 1`.

decls.name: bSigma_eq
decls.statement: theorem bSigma_eq {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : sigmaStar cyc (hitExp p) * Real.sqrt ((2 + (pol hp0 hp1).sigmaBar (hitExp p)) / minOver cyc (visits cyc (green p))) = (4 - p) / (1 - p) * Real.sqrt ((5 - 2 * p) / (1 - p))
decls.doc: **`prop:morozov_rate`*(2)* on this graph, with the constant computed**: `B̂_σ = σ_*√((2+σ̄)/min N) = ((4−p)/(1−p))·√((5−2p)/(1−p))`, finite at every `p ∈ (0,1)`.

decls.name: uInfl
decls.statement: noncomputable def uInfl (M : ℝ) : Fin 5 → ℝ
decls.doc: The over-inflated density of the remark: `u = M` on the cycle `{x₁,x₂,x₃}` and `u = 1` at the two marks.

decls.name: lam_pos
decls.statement: theorem lam_pos {p : ℝ} (hp1 : p < 1) (x : Fin 5) : 0 < lam p x

decls.name: uInfl_pos
decls.statement: theorem uInfl_pos {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (x : Fin 5) : 0 < uInfl M x

decls.name: den_ne
decls.statement: private theorem den_ne {p M : ℝ} (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 0 < M) (y : Fin 5) : lam p y * uInfl M y ≠ 0

decls.name: ratio_x1
decls.statement: theorem ratio_x1 {p M : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 0 < M) : Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 1 = 1
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, claim 3 at `x₁`**: `r(x₁) = 1` *exactly*, at every `M` — the remark's `→ 1` is attained, not approached.

decls.name: ratio_x2
decls.statement: theorem ratio_x2 {p M : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 0 < M) : Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 2 = 1
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, claim 3 at `x₂`**: `r(x₂) = 1` exactly.

decls.name: ratio_snk
decls.statement: theorem ratio_snk {p M : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 0 < M) : Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 4 = 1
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, claim 3 at `s_f`**: `r(s_f) = 1` exactly.

decls.name: ratio_x3
decls.statement: theorem ratio_x3 {p M : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 0 < M) : Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 3 = p + (1 - p) / M
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, claim 3 at `x₃`**: `r(x₃) = p + (1−p)/M` exactly, hence `→ p`.

decls.name: ratio_src
decls.statement: theorem ratio_src {p M : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 0 < M) : Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 0 = M
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, claim 3 at `s₀`**: on the paper's own convention `u = dμ/dλ` (`prop:no_distant_equilibrium`), `r(s₀) = M` *exactly*.

decls.name: den_one_ne
decls.statement: private theorem den_one_ne {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (y : Fin 5) : (1 : ℝ) * uInfl M y ≠ 0

decls.name: ratio_counting_src
decls.statement: theorem ratio_counting_src {p M : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 0 < M) : Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (fun _ => 1) (uInfl M) 0 = M * (1 - p)
decls.doc: **`r(s₀) = M(1−p)`, the remark's own value**, obtained by reading `u` as the density against the counting measure rather than against `λ`.

decls.name: ratio_counting_x3
decls.statement: theorem ratio_counting_x3 {p M : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 0 < M) : Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (fun _ => 1) (uInfl M) 3 = p + 1 / M
decls.doc: `r(x₃) = p + 1/M` against the counting measure — the same limit `p`.

decls.name: ratio_counting_ones
decls.statement: theorem ratio_counting_ones {p M : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 0 < M) : Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (fun _ => 1) (uInfl M) 1 = 1 ∧ Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (fun _ => 1) (uInfl M) 2 = 1 ∧ Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (fun _ => 1) (uInfl M) 4 = 1
decls.doc: `r(x₁) = r(x₂) = r(s_f) = 1` against the counting measure too.

decls.name: ratio_x3_tendsto
decls.statement: theorem ratio_x3_tendsto {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : Filter.Tendsto (fun M : ℝ => Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 3) Filter.atTop (nhds p)
decls.doc: **`r(x₃) → p`** as `M → ∞` (`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, claim 3).

decls.name: ratio_src_tendsto
decls.statement: theorem ratio_src_tendsto {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) : Filter.Tendsto (fun M : ℝ => Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 0) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
decls.doc: **`r(s₀) → ∞`** as `M → ∞`, linearly — the starved source of the remark.

decls.name: inflation_force
decls.statement: theorem inflation_force {p M : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 0 < M) : 2 * Real.log (Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 0) / Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 0 * Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 0 = 2 * Real.log M
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, claim 4, the magnitude**: for `g = (log x)²`, so `g'(x) = 2 log x / x`, the force at the starved source is `|g'(r)r| = 2 log r(s₀) = 2 log M` exactly (on the counting reading it is `2 log(M(1−p))`, the same to leading order).

decls.name: inflation_force_tendsto
decls.statement: theorem inflation_force_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun M : ℝ => 2 * Real.log M) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
decls.doc: **… and it *grows*, not vanishes, with the imbalance**: `2 log M → ∞`.

decls.name: no_stalemate
decls.statement: theorem no_stalemate {p M : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 1 < M) {w : Fin 5 → ℝ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x) : Balance.gradMass (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) w (fun x => 2 * Real.log x / x) < 0
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`, claim 4**: at the over-inflated configuration the total mass of the gradient density is *strictly* negative, for every training measure of positive density.

decls.name: cycle_no_stalemate
decls.statement: theorem cycle_no_stalemate {p M : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hM : 1 < M) {w : Fin 5 → ℝ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x) : (pol hp0 hp1).sigmaBar (hitExp p) = 3 / (1 - p) ∧ (∃ q : ℝ, 0 < q ∧ lam p 1 = q ∧ lam p 2 = q ∧ lam p 3 = q ∧ lam p 0 = (1 - p) * q ∧ lam p 4 = (1 - p) * q) ∧ (Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 1 = 1 ∧ Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 2 = 1 ∧ Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 4 = 1 ∧ Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 3 = p + (1 - p) / M ∧ Balance.ratio (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) 0 = M) ∧ Balance.gradMass (pol hp0 hp1).phat (lam p) (uInfl M) w (fun x => 2 * Real.log x / x) < 0
decls.doc: **`rem:cycle_no_stalemate`** (`proofs.tex:816–818`), its four claims at once, on the graph `cyc` with the frozen policy `pol` and the over-inflated density `uInfl M`.

files.title: Freezing the backward policy does not restore stability, and the loop closure is what makes the frozen family nonempty

decls.name: edgeInflow
decls.statement: def edgeInflow (F : V → V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the inflow of an edgeflow** (`proofs.tex:673`): `μ_F(v) := ∑_u F(u → v)`.

decls.name: edgeOutflow
decls.statement: def edgeOutflow (F : V → V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The outflow of an edgeflow, `∑_v F(u → v)`.

decls.name: IsCirculation
decls.statement: def IsCirculation (F : V → V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **A `0`-flow**, in the sense `eq:def_stability` quantifies over (`cv_divergence.tex:179–181`): an edgeflow that neither creates nor destroys mass at any vertex, i.e.

decls.name: MarkedCirculation
decls.statement: structure MarkedCirculation (G : MarkedGraph V)
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the unit circulation `1_γ`** (`proofs.tex:663`), as the hypothesis bundle its proof consumes: a non-negative circulation, not identically zero, with zero inflow at both marks.

decls.name: exists_apply_ne_zero
decls.statement: theorem exists_apply_ne_zero {c : V → V → ℝ} (hne : c ≠ 0) : ∃ u v, c u v ≠ 0
decls.doc: A non-zero edgeflow is non-zero at some transition, in the form the sums below want.

decls.name: MarkedCirculation.exists_ne_zero
decls.statement: theorem MarkedCirculation.exists_ne_zero {G : MarkedGraph V} (γ : MarkedCirculation G) : ∃ u v, γ.circ u v ≠ 0
decls.doc: `1_γ` is somewhere non-zero.

decls.name: epsCirc
decls.statement: def epsCirc (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the `0`-flow `F₀ := ε 1_γ`** (`proofs.tex:665`).

decls.name: epsCirc_apply
decls.statement: theorem epsCirc_apply (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) (u v : V) : epsCirc eps c u v = eps * c u v
decls.doc: `ε 1_γ`, evaluated.

decls.name: epsCirc_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem epsCirc_nonneg {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 ≤ eps) {c : V → V → ℝ} (hc : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ c u v) (u v : V) : 0 ≤ epsCirc eps c u v
decls.doc: `F₀ = ε 1_γ ≥ 0` for `ε ≥ 0` — the first conjunct of the proposition's display.

decls.name: edgeInflow_epsCirc
decls.statement: theorem edgeInflow_epsCirc (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) (v : V) : edgeInflow (epsCirc eps c) v = eps * edgeInflow c v
decls.doc: The inflow of `ε 1_γ` is `ε ∂γ`.

decls.name: edgeOutflow_epsCirc
decls.statement: theorem edgeOutflow_epsCirc (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) (u : V) : edgeOutflow (epsCirc eps c) u = eps * edgeOutflow c u
decls.doc: The outflow of `ε 1_γ` is `ε` times that of `1_γ`.

decls.name: isCirculation_epsCirc
decls.statement: theorem isCirculation_epsCirc (eps : ℝ) {c : V → V → ℝ} (hc : IsCirculation c) : IsCirculation (epsCirc eps c)
decls.doc: **`F₀ = ε1_γ` is a `0`-flow**: scaling a circulation gives a circulation.

decls.name: sum_edgeInflow_pos
decls.statement: theorem sum_edgeInflow_pos {c : V → V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ c u v) (hne : c ≠ 0) : 0 < ∑ v, edgeInflow c v
decls.doc: **`∂γ ≠ 0`** in the only form the proof of `𝓛_{g,ν}(F) > 0` needs: the total mass of the inflow of a non-negative, non-zero edgeflow is positive.

decls.name: stateRatio
decls.statement: noncomputable def stateRatio (mu : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the ratio `r = d(μ π̂_←)/dμ`** (`proofs.tex:673`), in the coordinates of `GFNBounds.Balance`: `μ = u λ` at `λ := μ` and `u := 1`, so that `ratio π̂_← μ 1 = (μ π̂_←)/μ`.

decls.name: stateRatio_apply
decls.statement: theorem stateRatio_apply (mu : V → ℝ) (y : V) : B.stateRatio mu y = (∑ x, mu x * B.phat x y) / mu y

decls.name: balanced_iff
decls.statement: theorem balanced_iff (mu : V → ℝ) : Balance.Balanced B.phat mu 1 ↔ ∀ y, ∑ x, mu x * B.phat x y = mu y
decls.doc: `GFNBounds.Balance`'s `Balanced` at these coordinates is invariance of the state flow.

decls.name: stateRatio_eq_one_iff
decls.statement: theorem stateRatio_eq_one_iff {mu : V → ℝ} (hmu : ∀ y, 0 < mu y) : (∀ y, B.stateRatio mu y = 1) ↔ ∀ y, ∑ x, mu x * B.phat x y = mu y
decls.doc: **`r ≡ 1` if and only if the state flow is `π̂_←`-invariant** — `ratio_eq_one_iff_balanced` of `GFNBounds.Balance`, read here.

decls.name: fmLoss
decls.statement: noncomputable def fmLoss (g : ℝ → ℝ) (nu mu : V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the FM loss with a frozen backward policy** (`proofs.tex:673`): `𝓛_{g,ν}(μ) = ∫ g(r) dν = ∑_x ν(x) g(r(x))`, a function of the state flow alone.

decls.name: exists_phat_pos_into
decls.statement: theorem exists_phat_pos_into {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (y : V) : ∃ x, 0 < B.phat x y
decls.doc: Every state receives mass from somewhere under `π̂_←`: an invariant probability that is positive somewhere is positive at `y`, so some term of `∑_x λ(x) π̂_←(x → y) = λ(y) > 0` is.

decls.name: stateRatio_pos
decls.statement: theorem stateRatio_pos {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) {mu : V → ℝ} (hmu : ∀ x, 0 < mu x) (y : V) : 0 < B.stateRatio mu y
decls.doc: **The ratio is positive at every state flow of positive density.** The paper's `g > 0` elsewhere is a statement on `ℝ_{>0}`, so this is what lets it be applied.

decls.name: fmLoss_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem fmLoss_eq_zero {mu : V → ℝ} (hmu : ∀ y, 0 < mu y) (hinv : ∀ y, ∑ x, mu x * B.phat x y = mu y) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (nu : V → ℝ) : B.fmLoss g nu mu = 0
decls.doc: **`𝓛_{g,ν}(F + F₀) = 0`** (`proofs.tex:678`), in its general form: at a state flow that is `π̂_←`-invariant the ratio is `≡ 1` and `g(1) = 0`.

decls.name: fmLoss_pos
decls.statement: theorem fmLoss_pos {mu : V → ℝ} (hr : ∀ y, 0 < B.stateRatio mu y) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) {nu : V → ℝ} (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) {y : V} (hy : B.stateRatio mu y ≠ 1) : 0 < B.fmLoss g nu mu
decls.doc: **`𝓛_{g,ν}(F) > 0`** (`proofs.tex:676`), in its general form: `ν > 0`, `g ≥ 0` on the ratios and `g > 0` at one of them.

decls.name: AdmissibleEps
decls.statement: def AdmissibleEps (lam : V → ℝ) (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the admissible `ε`** (`proofs.tex:664`): `2 ε 1_γ ≤ F*` edgewise, which is the form the *Admissibility* step uses and, for a `{0,1}`-valued `1_γ`, is the statement's `ε ≤ ½ min_{(u→v)∈γ} F*(u→v)`.

decls.name: perturbedFlow
decls.statement: noncomputable def perturbedFlow (lam : V → ℝ) (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the perturbed edgeflow `F := F* − ε1_γ`** (`proofs.tex:665`).

decls.name: edgeFlow_pos_of_hatEdge
decls.statement: theorem edgeFlow_pos_of_hatEdge (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {u v : V} (he : G.hatEdge u v) : 0 < B.edgeFlow lam c u v
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, *Admissibility*, first half** (`proofs.tex:675`): `λ > 0` and `π̂_← > 0` give `F* > 0` on every edge of `Ĝ` — on an edge of `G` by `PositiveOnEdges`, on the wrap edge because `π̂_←(s₀ → s_f) = 1`.

decls.name: exists_admissibleEps
decls.statement: theorem exists_admissibleEps (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (γ : MarkedCirculation G) (hsupp : ∀ u v, γ.circ u v ≠ 0 → G.hatEdge u v) : ∃ eps : ℝ, 0 < eps ∧ B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, *Admissibility*, second half** (`proofs.tex:675`): "`ε` is well defined and positive".

decls.name: epsCirc_le_perturbedFlow
decls.statement: theorem epsCirc_le_perturbedFlow {lam : V → ℝ} {eps : ℝ} {c : V → V → ℝ} (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps c) (u v : V) : epsCirc eps c u v ≤ B.perturbedFlow lam eps c u v
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, *Admissibility*** (`proofs.tex:675`): `2ε1_γ ≤ F*` edgewise gives `F₀ = ε1_γ ≤ F* − ε1_γ = F`.

decls.name: perturbedFlow_add_epsCirc
decls.statement: theorem perturbedFlow_add_epsCirc (lam : V → ℝ) (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) : B.perturbedFlow lam eps c + epsCirc eps c = B.edgeFlow lam 1
decls.doc: **`F + F₀ = F*`** (`proofs.tex:678`).

decls.name: edgeInflow_edgeFlow_one
decls.statement: theorem edgeInflow_edgeFlow_one (lam : V → ℝ) : edgeInflow (B.edgeFlow lam 1) = lam
decls.doc: **`μ_{F*} = λ`** (`proofs.tex:673`), "since the rows of `π̂_←` sum to `1`".

decls.name: edgeInflow_perturbedFlow
decls.statement: theorem edgeInflow_perturbedFlow (lam : V → ℝ) (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) (v : V) : edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps c) v = lam v - eps * edgeInflow c v
decls.doc: **`μ_F = λ − ε ∂γ`** (`proofs.tex:676`).

decls.name: edgeInflow_perturbedFlow_ge
decls.statement: theorem edgeInflow_perturbedFlow_ge {lam : V → ℝ} {eps : ℝ} {c : V → V → ℝ} (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps c) (v : V) : lam v / 2 ≤ edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps c) v
decls.doc: **The perturbed state flow is at least `λ/2`, hence positive.** This is the point at which `eq_smul_invProb` — uniqueness of the invariant measure among *non-negative* vectors — becomes applicable to `μ_F`, and the paper's `ε` hypothesis is exactly what buys it: summing `ε 1_γ(u→v) ≤ ½ F*(u→v)` over `u` against `∑_u F*(u→v) = λ(v)` gives `ε ∂γ(v) ≤ ½ λ(v)`.

decls.name: sum_edgeInflow_perturbedFlow
decls.statement: theorem sum_edgeInflow_perturbedFlow {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (eps : ℝ) (c : V → V → ℝ) : ∑ v, edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps c) v = 1 - eps * ∑ v, edgeInflow c v
decls.doc: The total mass of the perturbed state flow, `∑ μ_F = 1 − ε ∑_v ∂γ(v)`.

decls.name: isCirculation_perturbedFlow
decls.statement: theorem isCirculation_perturbedFlow {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (eps : ℝ) {c : V → V → ℝ} (hc : IsCirculation c) : IsCirculation (B.perturbedFlow lam eps c)
decls.doc: **`F = F* − ε1_γ` is again a `0`-flow**: `F*` is a circulation (`theo:universality_graphs`*(3)*, `proofs.tex:995–996`) and so is `ε1_γ`.

decls.name: not_invariant_perturbedFlow
decls.statement: theorem not_invariant_perturbedFlow (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (γ : MarkedCirculation G) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ) : ¬ ∀ y, ∑ x, edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ) x * B.phat x y = edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ) y
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the step `𝓛_{g,ν}(F) > 0` rests on** (`proofs.tex:676`): `μ_F π̂_← ≠ μ_F`.

decls.name: frozen_unstable_full_fm
decls.statement: theorem frozen_unstable_full_fm (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (γ : MarkedCirculation G) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg1 : g 1 = 0) (hgpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ≠ 1 → 0 < g x) {nu : V → ℝ} (hnu : ∀ x, 0 < nu x) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hadm : B.AdmissibleEps lam eps γ.circ) : (∀ u v, 0 ≤ epsCirc eps γ.circ u v) ∧ (∀ u v, epsCirc eps γ.circ u v ≤ B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ u v) ∧ B.fmLoss g nu (edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ + epsCirc eps γ.circ)) = 0 ∧ 0 < B.fmLoss g nu (edgeInflow (B.perturbedFlow lam eps γ.circ))
decls.doc: **`prop:frozen_unstable_full`, the FM half** (statement `proofs.tex:659–669`, proof `proofs.tex:671–683`), in one statement.

decls.name: pcut
decls.statement: noncomputable def pcut : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`, the backward kernel of `G` itself** (`proofs.tex:1014`): `π_←` with the row at `s₀` emptied.

decls.name: pcut_src
decls.statement: @[simp] theorem pcut_src (s' : V) : B.pcut G.src s' = 0

decls.name: pcut_of_ne_src
decls.statement: theorem pcut_of_ne_src {s : V} (hs : s ≠ G.src) (s' : V) : B.pcut s s' = B.pb s s'

decls.name: pcut_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem pcut_nonneg (s s' : V) : 0 ≤ B.pcut s s'

decls.name: pcut_row_sum_of_ne_src
decls.statement: theorem pcut_row_sum_of_ne_src {s : V} (hs : s ≠ G.src) : ∑ s', B.pcut s s' = 1
decls.doc: Off the source, `π_←` is a probability: `pcut` inherits `row_sum`.

decls.name: pcut_row_sum_src
decls.statement: theorem pcut_row_sum_src : ∑ s', B.pcut G.src s' = 0
decls.doc: At the source the row is empty: this is the deficit the marginal argument reads off.

decls.name: CutBalance
decls.statement: def CutBalance (pf : V → V → ℝ) (fout : V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`, the frozen-backward family on `G`** (`proofs.tex:1014`): the family `Θ_{π_←}` of `theo:universality_graphs`*(2)* with `π̂_←` replaced by the kernel of `G` itself, in the same coordinates — `f_out(u) π_→(u → v) = π_←(v → u) f_out(v)` at every transition.

decls.name: cutBalance_zero
decls.statement: theorem cutBalance_zero (pf : V → V → ℝ) : B.CutBalance pf 0
decls.doc: The family is not empty: `f_out ≡ 0` is in it, whatever the forward policy.

decls.name: cutBalance_invariant
decls.statement: theorem cutBalance_invariant {pf : V → V → ℝ} {fout : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ u, ∑ v, pf u v = 1) (hcb : B.CutBalance pf fout) (u : V) : ∑ v, fout v * B.pcut v u = fout u
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`, the marginal argument** (`proofs.tex:1014`): summing the constraint over `v` at fixed `u`, the rows of `π_→` summing to `1`, makes `f_out μ` invariant under `π_←`.

decls.name: cutBalance_src_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem cutBalance_src_eq_zero {pf : V → V → ℝ} {fout : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ u, ∑ v, pf u v = 1) (hcb : B.CutBalance pf fout) : fout G.src = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`: the marginal argument forces `f_out(s₀) = 0`** (`proofs.tex:1014`).

decls.name: cutInvariant_step
decls.statement: theorem cutInvariant_step (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {fout : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ fout x) (hinv : ∀ u, ∑ v, fout v * B.pcut v u = fout u) {u v : V} (he : G.Edge u v) (hu : fout u = 0) : fout v = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`: the zero propagates along the edges of `G`.** Invariance under `π_←` reads `f_out(u) = ∑_v f_out(v) π_←(v → u)` with every term non-negative, so `f_out(u) = 0` kills every term; and `π_←(v → u) > 0` at every out-neighbour `v` of `u`, by `PositiveOnEdges` and because such a `v` is not the source.

decls.name: cutInvariant_eq_zero_of_reach
decls.statement: theorem cutInvariant_eq_zero_of_reach (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {fout : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ fout x) (hinv : ∀ u, ∑ v, fout v * B.pcut v u = fout u) {a b : V} (hr : G.Reach a b) (ha : fout a = 0) : fout b = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`: the zero propagates along a walk of `G`** — the one-step lemma iterated along `Relation.ReflTransGen`.

decls.name: loop_closure_necessary
decls.statement: theorem loop_closure_necessary (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {pf : V → V → ℝ} {fout : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ u, ∑ v, pf u v = 1) (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ fout x) (hcb : B.CutBalance pf fout) : fout = 0
decls.doc: **`rem:loop_closure_necessary`** (`proofs.tex:1014–1016`): *on `G` itself, i.e.

files.title: The training rate in the variables of Morozov et al., with no Markov chain underneath

decls.name: maxOver
decls.statement: noncomputable def maxOver (G : MarkedGraph V) (u : V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `max_x u(x)` over the vertices of a marked graph.

decls.name: minOver
decls.statement: noncomputable def minOver (G : MarkedGraph V) (u : V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `min_x u(x)` over the vertices of a marked graph.

decls.name: le_maxOver
decls.statement: theorem le_maxOver (u : V → ℝ) (x : V) : u x ≤ maxOver G u

decls.name: maxOver_le
decls.statement: theorem maxOver_le {u : V → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, u x ≤ c) : maxOver G u ≤ c

decls.name: minOver_le
decls.statement: theorem minOver_le (u : V → ℝ) (x : V) : minOver G u ≤ u x

decls.name: le_minOver
decls.statement: theorem le_minOver {u : V → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, c ≤ u x) : c ≤ minOver G u

decls.name: minOver_pos
decls.statement: theorem minOver_pos {u : V → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, 0 < u x) : 0 < minOver G u

decls.name: supAbs
decls.statement: noncomputable def supAbs (G : MarkedGraph V) (f : V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `‖f‖_{L^∞}` on a finite vertex set.

decls.name: le_supAbs
decls.statement: theorem le_supAbs (f : V → ℝ) (x : V) : |f x| ≤ supAbs G f

decls.name: supAbs_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem supAbs_nonneg (f : V → ℝ) : 0 ≤ supAbs G f

decls.name: supAbs_le
decls.statement: theorem supAbs_le {f : V → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ c) : supAbs G f ≤ c

decls.name: sigmaStar
decls.statement: noncomputable def sigmaStar (G : MarkedGraph V) (u : V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `σ_* := max_x E(σ ∣ X₀ = x)` (`proofs.tex:837`).

decls.name: le_sigmaStar
decls.statement: theorem le_sigmaStar (u : V → ℝ) (x : V) : u x ≤ sigmaStar G u

decls.name: ipL2
decls.statement: def ipL2 (lam a b : V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `⟪a ∣ b⟫_{L²(λ)} = ∫ a b dλ`.

decls.name: nrmL2
decls.statement: noncomputable def nrmL2 (lam a : V → ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: meanL2
decls.statement: def meanL2 (lam a : V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `Π a`, the mean of `a` against `λ` — a scalar, `Π` being the mean projection onto the constants (`proofs.tex:22`).

decls.name: ipL2_self_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_self_nonneg {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (a : V → ℝ) : 0 ≤ ipL2 lam a a

decls.name: nrmL2_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_nonneg (lam a : V → ℝ) : 0 ≤ nrmL2 lam a

decls.name: sq_nrmL2
decls.statement: theorem sq_nrmL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (a : V → ℝ) : nrmL2 lam a ^ 2 = ipL2 lam a a

decls.name: ipL2_le_mul_nrmL2
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_le_mul_nrmL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (a b : V → ℝ) : ipL2 lam a b ≤ nrmL2 lam a * nrmL2 lam b
decls.doc: **Cauchy–Schwarz in `L²(λ)`.**

decls.name: nrmL2_le_supAbs
decls.statement: theorem nrmL2_le_supAbs {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (htot : ∑ x, lam x = 1) (a : V → ℝ) : nrmL2 lam a ≤ supAbs G a
decls.doc: `‖a‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ ‖a‖_{L^∞}` when `λ` is a probability.

decls.name: sqrt_minOver_mul_abs_le_nrmL2
decls.statement: theorem sqrt_minOver_mul_abs_le_nrmL2 {lam : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (a : V → ℝ) (x : V) : Real.sqrt (minOver G lam) * |a x| ≤ nrmL2 lam a

decls.name: visits
decls.statement: def visits (G : MarkedGraph V) (g : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`N`**, the paper's visit counts (`proofs.tex:840`): the occupation measure `g` of the backward chain killed at `s₀` — see `BackwardPolicy.IsGreen` — plus the one visit each to `s₀` and `s_f` that the convention `N(s₀) = N(s_f) = 1` records.

decls.name: qact
decls.statement: noncomputable def qact (u : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The **function action** `Q` of the backward chain: `(Qu)(x) = ∑_y π̂_←(x→y) u(y)`.

decls.name: qact_apply
decls.statement: theorem qact_apply (u : V → ℝ) (x : V) : B.qact u x = ∑ y, B.phat x y * u y

decls.name: qact_const
decls.statement: theorem qact_const (c : ℝ) (x : V) : B.qact (fun _ => c) x = c

decls.name: qact_sub
decls.statement: theorem qact_sub (u u' : V → ℝ) (x : V) : B.qact (fun z => u z - u' z) x = B.qact u x - B.qact u' x

decls.name: qact_neg
decls.statement: theorem qact_neg (u : V → ℝ) (x : V) : B.qact (fun z => -u z) x = -B.qact u x

decls.name: qact_smul
decls.statement: theorem qact_smul (c : ℝ) (u : V → ℝ) (x : V) : B.qact (fun z => c * u z) x = c * B.qact u x

decls.name: qact_le
decls.statement: theorem qact_le {u : V → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (h : ∀ y, u y ≤ c) (x : V) : B.qact u x ≤ c

decls.name: le_qact
decls.statement: theorem le_qact {u : V → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (h : ∀ y, c ≤ u y) (x : V) : c ≤ B.qact u x

decls.name: eq_of_bstep_of_min
decls.statement: theorem eq_of_bstep_of_min {φ : V → ℝ} {m : ℝ} (hm : ∀ z, m ≤ φ z) {x : V} (hx : φ x = m) (hs : B.qact φ x ≤ φ x) {y : V} (hxy : B.BStep x y) : φ y = m
decls.doc: A minimizer of `φ` at which `φ` is superharmonic passes its value to every state the backward chain can step to.

decls.name: eq_of_breach_of_min
decls.statement: theorem eq_of_breach_of_min {φ : V → ℝ} {m : ℝ} (hm : ∀ z, m ≤ φ z) (hoff : ∀ z, φ z = m → B.qact φ z ≤ φ z) {x y : V} (hx : φ x = m) (hr : B.BReach x y) : φ y = m
decls.doc: The minimizing set propagates along walks of the backward chain, as long as `φ` is superharmonic at each state it passes.

decls.name: nonneg_of_superharm_off_src
decls.statement: theorem nonneg_of_superharm_off_src (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {φ : V → ℝ} (h0 : φ G.src = 0) (hs : ∀ x, x ≠ G.src → B.qact φ x ≤ φ x) (x : V) : 0 ≤ φ x
decls.doc: **The minimum principle at `s₀`.** A function vanishing at the regeneration state and superharmonic for the backward chain off it is non-negative.

decls.name: IsPoisson
decls.statement: def IsPoisson (f u : V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **The Poisson system at the regeneration state.** `u(s₀) = 0` and `u = f + Qu` off `s₀`.

decls.name: eq_zero_of_harm_off_src
decls.statement: theorem eq_zero_of_harm_off_src (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {d : V → ℝ} (h0 : d G.src = 0) (hh : ∀ x, x ≠ G.src → d x = B.qact d x) : d = 0
decls.doc: A function vanishing at `s₀` and `Q`-harmonic off `s₀` vanishes identically: the minimum principle applied to `d` and to `−d`.

decls.name: IsPoisson.unique
decls.statement: theorem IsPoisson.unique (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {f u u' : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsPoisson f u) (h' : B.IsPoisson f u') : u = u'
decls.doc: **The Poisson system has at most one solution.**

decls.name: poissonMap
decls.statement: noncomputable def poissonMap : (V → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (V → ℝ)
decls.doc: The linear map whose kernel is the homogeneous Poisson system: `u ↦ u(s₀)` at `s₀` and `u ↦ u − Qu` elsewhere.

decls.name: poissonMap_apply
decls.statement: theorem poissonMap_apply (u : V → ℝ) (x : V) : B.poissonMap u x = if x = G.src then u G.src else u x - B.qact u x

decls.name: exists_isPoisson
decls.statement: theorem exists_isPoisson (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (f : V → ℝ) : ∃ u, B.IsPoisson f u
decls.doc: **The Poisson system is solvable, for every source term.**

decls.name: IsHitExp
decls.statement: def IsHitExp (u : V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **`E(σ ∣ X₀ = ·)`, characterized**: the Poisson system with unit source.

decls.name: exists_isHitExp
decls.statement: theorem exists_isHitExp (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) : ∃ u, B.IsHitExp u

decls.name: IsHitExp.unique
decls.statement: theorem IsHitExp.unique (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {u u' : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsHitExp u) (h' : B.IsHitExp u') : u = u'

decls.name: IsHitExp.nonneg
decls.statement: theorem IsHitExp.nonneg {u : V → ℝ} (hu : B.IsHitExp u) (x : V) : 0 ≤ u x
decls.doc: `E(σ ∣ X₀ = x) ≥ 0`: the minimum of `u` can only be at `s₀`, since anywhere else `u` exceeds its own average by `1`.

decls.name: sigmaBar
decls.statement: noncomputable def sigmaBar (u : V → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: `σ̄ := E_{x ∼ π̂_←(s_f→·)} E(σ ∣ X₀ = x)`, the expected backward-trajectory length of Morozov et al.

decls.name: sigmaStar_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem sigmaStar_nonneg {u : V → ℝ} (hu : B.IsHitExp u) : 0 ≤ sigmaStar G u

decls.name: sigmaBar_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem sigmaBar_nonneg {u : V → ℝ} (hu : B.IsHitExp u) : 0 ≤ B.sigmaBar u

decls.name: phat_snk_eq_zero_of_ne
decls.statement: theorem phat_snk_eq_zero_of_ne {x : V} (hx : x ≠ G.src) : B.phat x G.snk = 0
decls.doc: The only backward transition into `s_f` is from `s₀`: `s_f` has no outgoing edge in `G`.

decls.name: phat_src_src
decls.statement: theorem phat_src_src : B.phat G.src G.src = 0
decls.doc: `π̂_←(s₀→s₀) = 0`, the source row being the point mass at `s_f`.

decls.name: IsGreen
decls.statement: def IsGreen (g : V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **The occupation measure of the backward chain killed at `s₀`, characterized**: the renewal equation with the target row as source.

decls.name: eq_smul_lam_of_invariant
decls.statement: theorem eq_smul_lam_of_invariant (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam e : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (he : ∀ y, ∑ x, e x * B.phat x y = e y) (x : V) : e x = (∑ z, e z) * lam x
decls.doc: **`prop:morozov_rate`*(1)*, one-dimensionality.** An invariant signed measure of the backward chain is a multiple of `λ`: the ratio maximum principle of `theo:universality_graphs`*(1)*, with `eq_zero_of_breach` reused verbatim.

decls.name: IsGreen.flux
decls.statement: theorem IsGreen.flux {g : V → ℝ} (hg : B.IsGreen g) : B.densMap g G.src + B.phat G.snk G.src = 1
decls.doc: **The flux identity.** `(g P̂)(s₀) + π̂_←(s_f→s₀) = 1`: the killed chain reaches `s₀` with total mass one.

decls.name: IsGreen.snk
decls.statement: theorem IsGreen.snk {g : V → ℝ} (hg : B.IsGreen g) : g G.snk = 0
decls.doc: The killed occupation measure does not charge `s_f`: nothing but `s₀` steps into `s_f`, and `g(s₀) = 0`.

decls.name: IsGreen.unique
decls.statement: theorem IsGreen.unique (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam g g' : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hg' : B.IsGreen g') : g = g'

decls.name: greenMap
decls.statement: noncomputable def greenMap : (V → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (V → ℝ)
decls.doc: The linear map whose kernel is the homogeneous renewal system.

decls.name: greenMap_apply
decls.statement: theorem greenMap_apply (e : V → ℝ) (y : V) : B.greenMap e y = if y = G.src then e G.src else e y - B.densMap e y

decls.name: exists_isGreen
decls.statement: theorem exists_isGreen (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) : ∃ g, B.IsGreen g
decls.doc: **The renewal system is solvable**: `N` exists.

decls.name: IsGreen.visits_src
decls.statement: theorem IsGreen.visits_src {g : V → ℝ} (hg : B.IsGreen g) : visits G g G.src = 1
decls.doc: **`prop:morozov_rate`*(1)*, `N(s₀) = 1`** — the paper's convention, here a consequence of `g(s₀) = 0`.

decls.name: IsGreen.visits_snk
decls.statement: theorem IsGreen.visits_snk {g : V → ℝ} (hg : B.IsGreen g) : visits G g G.snk = 1
decls.doc: **`prop:morozov_rate`*(1)*, `N(s_f) = 1`** — likewise, from `g(s_f) = 0`.

decls.name: IsGreen.visits_invariant
decls.statement: theorem IsGreen.visits_invariant {g : V → ℝ} (hg : B.IsGreen g) (y : V) : ∑ x, visits G g x * B.phat x y = visits G g y
decls.doc: **`N` is `P̂`-invariant.** The renewal equation off `s₀` plus the flux identity at `s₀`; the two indicator terms carry the wrap `s₀ → s_f` and the target row out of `s_f`.

decls.name: IsGreen.sum_eq_sigmaBar
decls.statement: theorem IsGreen.sum_eq_sigmaBar {g u : V → ℝ} (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hu : B.IsHitExp u) : ∑ x, g x = B.sigmaBar u
decls.doc: **The duality identity.** `∑_x g(x) = σ̄`: pairing the renewal system for `g` against the hitting system for `u` collapses to the total mass on one side and the target-row average on the other.

decls.name: IsGreen.sum_visits
decls.statement: theorem IsGreen.sum_visits {g u : V → ℝ} (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hu : B.IsHitExp u) : ∑ x, visits G g x = 2 + B.sigmaBar u
decls.doc: `∑_x N(x) = 2 + σ̄`: the expected length of one excursion from `s₀`, which is what Kac's formula divides by.

decls.name: two_add_sigmaBar_pos
decls.statement: theorem two_add_sigmaBar_pos {u : V → ℝ} (hu : B.IsHitExp u) : 0 < 2 + B.sigmaBar u

decls.name: lam_eq_visits_div
decls.statement: theorem lam_eq_visits_div (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam g u : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hu : B.IsHitExp u) (x : V) : lam x = visits G g x / (2 + B.sigmaBar u)
decls.doc: **`prop:morozov_rate`*(1)***: `λ(x) = N(x)/(2 + σ̄)` for every `x`.

decls.name: lam_src_eq
decls.statement: theorem lam_src_eq (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam g u : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hu : B.IsHitExp u) : lam G.src = 1 / (2 + B.sigmaBar u)
decls.doc: **`prop:morozov_rate`*(1)*, at the source**: `λ(s₀) = 1/(2+σ̄)`.

decls.name: lam_snk_eq
decls.statement: theorem lam_snk_eq (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam g u : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hu : B.IsHitExp u) : lam G.snk = 1 / (2 + B.sigmaBar u)
decls.doc: **`prop:morozov_rate`*(1)*, at the sink**: `λ(s_f) = 1/(2+σ̄)`.

decls.name: IsGreen.visits_pos
decls.statement: theorem IsGreen.visits_pos (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam g u : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hu : B.IsHitExp u) (x : V) : 0 < visits G g x
decls.doc: **`min_x N(x) > 0`**, which is what makes `B̂_σ` a finite constant: `N = (2+σ̄)λ` and `λ > 0`.

decls.name: pdens
decls.statement: noncomputable def pdens (lam a : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ
decls.doc: The **density action** `P` of the backward chain, read on `L²(λ)` densities (`proofs.tex:22`, `proofs.tex:407`): `(Pa)(y) = (∑_x λ(x) π̂_←(x→y) a(x))/λ(y)`, which is the function action of the `λ`-reversal.

decls.name: ipL2_pdens_qact
decls.statement: theorem ipL2_pdens_qact {lam : V → ℝ} (hp : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (a b : V → ℝ) : ipL2 lam (B.pdens lam a) b = ipL2 lam a (B.qact b)
decls.doc: **`P` and `Q` are `L²(λ)`-adjoint** (`proofs.tex:861`), by a swap of two finite sums.

decls.name: pdens_const
decls.statement: theorem pdens_const {lam : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hp : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (c : ℝ) (y : V) : B.pdens lam (fun _ => c) y = c
decls.doc: `P` fixes the constants: `λ` is invariant.

decls.name: pdens_sub
decls.statement: theorem pdens_sub (lam a a' : V → ℝ) (y : V) : B.pdens lam (fun z => a z - a' z) y = B.pdens lam a y - B.pdens lam a' y

decls.name: IsPoisson.at_src
decls.statement: theorem IsPoisson.at_src {lam f w : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hp : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (hw : B.IsPoisson f w) (hf : meanL2 lam f = 0) : ∀ x, w x - B.qact w x = f x
decls.doc: **The Poisson solution is closed at `s₀` too** when the source is mean-zero (`proofs.tex:865`): the paper gets it from the occupation identity of item *(1)*, here it is invariance of `λ` tested against `u − Qu`.

decls.name: IsPoisson.le_smul_hitExp
decls.statement: theorem IsPoisson.le_smul_hitExp (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {f w u : V → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hw : B.IsPoisson f w) (hu : B.IsHitExp u) (hc : ∀ x, f x ≤ c) (x : V) : w x ≤ c * u x
decls.doc: **`‖u_f‖_∞ ≤ ‖f‖_∞ σ_*`, the comparison form.** `φ := c·u − w` vanishes at `s₀` and is superharmonic off it, `c − f ≥ 0` being the slack; the minimum principle does the rest.

decls.name: IsPoisson.neg
decls.statement: theorem IsPoisson.neg {f w : V → ℝ} (hw : B.IsPoisson f w) : B.IsPoisson (fun z => -f z) (fun z => -w z)

decls.name: IsPoisson.abs_le_supAbs_mul_sigmaStar
decls.statement: theorem IsPoisson.abs_le_supAbs_mul_sigmaStar (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {f w u : V → ℝ} (hw : B.IsPoisson f w) (hu : B.IsHitExp u) (x : V) : |w x| ≤ supAbs G f * sigmaStar G u
decls.doc: **`‖u_f‖_∞ ≤ ‖f‖_∞ σ_*`** (`proofs.tex:868`), both signs.

decls.name: coercivity_lamMin
decls.statement: theorem coercivity_lamMin (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam u : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hu : B.IsHitExp u) (h : V → ℝ) : nrmL2 lam (fun x => h x - meanL2 lam h) ≤ sigmaStar G u / Real.sqrt (minOver G lam) * nrmL2 lam (fun x => h x - B.pdens lam h x)
decls.doc: **`prop:morozov_rate`*(2)*, in the `σ_*/√λ_min` form of `proofs.tex:931`**: `‖h − Πh‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ (σ_*/√(min λ)) ‖(I−P)h‖_{L²(λ)}`.

decls.name: coercivity_morozov
decls.statement: theorem coercivity_morozov (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam g u : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hu : B.IsHitExp u) (h : V → ℝ) : nrmL2 lam (fun x => h x - meanL2 lam h) ≤ sigmaStar G u * Real.sqrt ((2 + B.sigmaBar u) / minOver G (visits G g)) * nrmL2 lam (fun x => h x - B.pdens lam h x)
decls.doc: **`prop:morozov_rate`*(2)***: `‖h − Πh‖_{L²(λ)} ≤ B̂_σ ‖(I−P)h‖_{L²(λ)}` with `B̂_σ = σ_*√((2+σ̄)/min_x N(x))`.

decls.name: morozov_rate
decls.statement: theorem morozov_rate (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam g u : V → ℝ} (hl : B.IsInvProb lam) (hg : B.IsGreen g) (hu : B.IsHitExp u) : (∀ x, lam x = visits G g x / (2 + B.sigmaBar u)) ∧ lam G.src = 1 / (2 + B.sigmaBar u) ∧ lam G.snk = 1 / (2 + B.sigmaBar u) ∧ ∀ h : V → ℝ, nrmL2 lam (fun x => h x - meanL2 lam h) ≤ sigmaStar G u * Real.sqrt ((2 + B.sigmaBar u) / minOver G (visits G g)) * nrmL2 lam (fun x => h x - B.pdens lam h x)
decls.doc: **`prop:morozov_rate`, items *(1)* and *(2)***, on the loop closure of a finite path-connected marked graph with a backward policy positive on its edges: `λ(x) = N(x)/(2+σ̄)` with `λ(s₀) = λ(s_f) = 1/(2+σ̄)`, and the coercivity with `B̂_σ = σ_*√((2+σ̄)/min N)`.

decls.name: Leveled
decls.statement: structure Leveled (G : MarkedGraph V)
decls.doc: A **leveled** marked graph: a height rising by exactly one along every edge, with the source at height `0`.

decls.name: lvl_mono
decls.statement: theorem lvl_mono {x y : V} (h : G.Reach x y) : L.lvl x ≤ L.lvl y
decls.doc: The height is monotone along walks of `G`.

decls.name: isHitExp
decls.statement: theorem isHitExp : B.IsHitExp L.lvl
decls.doc: **On a leveled graph the height *is* the hitting time.** Off `s₀` every backward step drops the height by exactly one, so `ℓ = 1 + Qℓ`; with `ℓ(s₀) = 0` that is the hitting system, and by uniqueness `E(σ ∣ X₀ = ·) = ℓ`.

decls.name: sigmaStar_eq
decls.statement: theorem sigmaStar_eq (hpc : G.PathConnected) : sigmaStar G L.lvl = L.lvl G.snk
decls.doc: `σ_* = t_m`: the sink is the unique maximum of the height, every vertex reaching it.

decls.name: sigmaBar_eq
decls.statement: theorem sigmaBar_eq : B.sigmaBar L.lvl = L.lvl G.snk - 1
decls.doc: `σ̄ = t_m − 1`: the target row sits one level below the sink.

decls.name: bsigma_le
decls.statement: theorem bsigma_le (hpc : G.PathConnected) {N : V → ℝ} (hN : 0 < minOver G N) : sigmaStar G L.lvl * Real.sqrt ((2 + B.sigmaBar L.lvl) / minOver G N) ≤ (L.lvl G.snk + 1) * Real.sqrt ((2 + L.lvl G.snk) / minOver G N)
decls.doc: **The leveled witness for `B̂_σ`** (`proofs.tex:855`): with `t_m := ℓ(s_f)`, `B̂_σ ≤ (t_m + 1)√((2 + t_m)/min_x N(x))` — a finite bound with no aperiodicity anywhere, on the graphs where the paper says the mixing constant `B̂` is infinite.

files.title: Finite marked graphs, their loop closure, and the invariant measure of the backward chain

decls.name: MarkedGraph
decls.statement: structure MarkedGraph (V : Type*)
decls.doc: A **marked graph** `G = (𝒱, ℰ)` (`proofs.tex:949`): a directed graph on `V` with a source `s₀` carrying no incoming edge and a sink `s_f` carrying no outgoing edge.

decls.name: Reach
decls.statement: abbrev Reach : V → V → Prop
decls.doc: Walks in `G`: the reflexive-transitive closure of the edge relation.

decls.name: PathConnected
decls.statement: def PathConnected : Prop
decls.doc: **`def:path_connected`** (`proofs.tex:951–953`): every vertex lies on a walk from the source to the sink, split at that vertex.

decls.name: hatEdge
decls.statement: def hatEdge (x y : V) : Prop
decls.doc: **`def:loop_closure`** (`proofs.tex:955–957`), the graph half: the edges of `Ĝ = (𝒱, ℰ ∪ {s_f → s₀})`.

decls.name: hatEdge_wrap
decls.statement: theorem hatEdge_wrap : G.hatEdge G.snk G.src
decls.doc: The wrap edge `s_f → s₀` of `Ĝ`.

decls.name: eq_snk_of_hatEdge_into_src
decls.statement: theorem eq_snk_of_hatEdge_into_src {x : V} (h : G.hatEdge x G.src) : x = G.snk
decls.doc: In `Ĝ` the wrap edge is the only incoming edge of `s₀`, because `s₀` had none in `G`.

decls.name: PathConnected.from_src
decls.statement: theorem PathConnected.from_src (h : G.PathConnected) (s : V) : G.Reach G.src s
decls.doc: The source half of path-connectedness.

decls.name: PathConnected.to_snk
decls.statement: theorem PathConnected.to_snk (h : G.PathConnected) (s : V) : G.Reach s G.snk
decls.doc: The sink half of path-connectedness.

decls.name: PathConnected.reach_src_snk
decls.statement: theorem PathConnected.reach_src_snk (h : G.PathConnected) (s : V) : G.Reach G.src G.snk
decls.doc: The two halves of `def:path_connected` concatenate at `s` into one walk `s₀ ⤳ s_f`, which is the form the definition is stated in.

decls.name: exists_hatEdge_into
decls.statement: theorem exists_hatEdge_into (h : G.PathConnected) (x : V) : ∃ y, G.hatEdge y x
decls.doc: **Every vertex of `Ĝ` has an incoming edge** — the first sentence of the proof of `theo:universality_graphs`*(1)*.

decls.name: BackwardPolicy
decls.statement: structure BackwardPolicy (G : MarkedGraph V)
decls.doc: A **backward policy** on a marked graph (`proofs.tex:949`): probability distributions `π_←(s → ·)` for each `s ≠ s₀`, supported on the in-neighbours of `s`.

decls.name: phat
decls.statement: noncomputable def phat : V → V → ℝ
decls.doc: **`def:loop_closure`** (`proofs.tex:955–957`), the policy half: the unique extension `π̂_←` of `π_←` to `Ĝ`, given by `π̂_←(s₀ → s_f) := 1` and `π̂_← = π_←` elsewhere.

decls.name: phat_src_snk
decls.statement: @[simp] theorem phat_src_snk : B.phat G.src G.snk = 1

decls.name: phat_src_of_ne
decls.statement: theorem phat_src_of_ne {s' : V} (h : s' ≠ G.snk) : B.phat G.src s' = 0

decls.name: phat_of_ne_src
decls.statement: theorem phat_of_ne_src {s s' : V} (h : s ≠ G.src) : B.phat s s' = B.pb s s'

decls.name: phat_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem phat_nonneg (s s' : V) : 0 ≤ B.phat s s'
decls.doc: `π̂_←` is non-negative.

decls.name: phat_row_sum
decls.statement: theorem phat_row_sum (s : V) : ∑ s', B.phat s s' = 1
decls.doc: **`π̂_←` is a genuine Markov kernel on `𝒱`**: its rows sum to `1` at *every* state, the source included, where the wrap edge carries the whole mass.

decls.name: phat_supp
decls.statement: theorem phat_supp {s s' : V} (h : B.phat s s' ≠ 0) : G.hatEdge s' s
decls.doc: `π̂_←` is a backward policy on `Ĝ`: it is supported on the in-neighbours of `s` in `Ĝ`.

decls.name: src_row_unique
decls.statement: theorem src_row_unique (q : V → ℝ) (htot : ∑ s', q s' = 1) (hsupp : ∀ s', q s' ≠ 0 → G.hatEdge s' G.src) : q = fun s' => if s' = G.snk then 1 else 0
decls.doc: **`def:loop_closure`, the source row.** A row summing to `1` and supported on the in-neighbours of `s₀` in `Ĝ` is the point mass at `s_f`, the wrap edge being the only one.

decls.name: phat_unique_extension
decls.statement: theorem phat_unique_extension (Q : V → V → ℝ) (hrow : ∀ s, ∑ s', Q s s' = 1) (hsupp : ∀ s s', Q s s' ≠ 0 → G.hatEdge s' s) (hoff : ∀ ⦃s⦄, s ≠ G.src → Q s = B.pb s) : Q = B.phat
decls.doc: **`def:loop_closure`: the extension is unique.** A backward policy `Q` on `Ĝ` — rows summing to `1`, supported on the in-neighbours in `Ĝ` — that agrees with `π_←` at every state other than `s₀` is `π̂_←`.

decls.name: PositiveOnEdges
decls.statement: def PositiveOnEdges : Prop
decls.doc: The hypothesis of `theo:universality_graphs`: `π_←(s → s') > 0` for **every** edge `s' → s` of `G`.

decls.name: phat_pos_of_edge
decls.statement: theorem phat_pos_of_edge (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {x y : V} (h : G.Edge x y) : 0 < B.phat y x
decls.doc: Reversing an edge of `G` gives a positive transition of the backward chain.

decls.name: BStep
decls.statement: def BStep (x y : V) : Prop
decls.doc: A positive one-step transition of the backward chain.

decls.name: BReach
decls.statement: abbrev BReach : V → V → Prop
decls.doc: Accessibility in the backward chain: the reflexive-transitive closure of `BStep`.

decls.name: bstep_wrap
decls.statement: theorem bstep_wrap : B.BStep G.src G.snk

decls.name: bstep_of_edge
decls.statement: theorem bstep_of_edge (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {x y : V} (h : G.Edge x y) : B.BStep y x

decls.name: breach_of_reach
decls.statement: theorem breach_of_reach (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {a b : V} (h : G.Reach a b) : B.BReach b a
decls.doc: **The backward chain reverses walks of `G`**, each reversed edge carrying `π_← > 0`.

decls.name: breach_all
decls.statement: theorem breach_all (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) (x y : V) : B.BReach x y
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(1)*, irreducibility.** From `s`, reverse a walk `s₀ ⤳ s` down to `s₀`, take the wrap edge to `s_f`, then reverse a walk `s' ⤳ s_f` down to `s'`.

decls.name: IsInvProb
decls.statement: structure IsInvProb (lam : V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: An **invariant probability** of the backward chain: `λ ≥ 0`, `λ(𝒱) = 1` and `λ π̂_← = λ`.

decls.name: densMap
decls.statement: noncomputable def densMap : (V → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (V → ℝ)
decls.doc: The density action `l ↦ l π̂_←` on measures, a linear endomorphism of the finite-dimensional space `V → ℝ`.

decls.name: densMap_apply
decls.statement: theorem densMap_apply (l : V → ℝ) (y : V) : B.densMap l y = ∑ x, l x * B.phat x y

decls.name: sum_densMap
decls.statement: theorem sum_densMap (l : V → ℝ) : ∑ y, B.densMap l y = ∑ x, l x
decls.doc: The density action preserves total mass: the rows of `π̂_←` sum to `1`.

decls.name: exists_fixed
decls.statement: theorem exists_fixed : ∃ l : V → ℝ, l ≠ 0 ∧ B.densMap l = l
decls.doc: `densMap − id` is not injective: its range lies in the mass-zero hyperplane, so it misses the constant `1` and is not surjective, and `V → ℝ` is finite-dimensional.

decls.name: exists_invProb
decls.statement: theorem exists_invProb : ∃ lam : V → ℝ, B.IsInvProb lam
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(1)*, existence.** `|l|` of a non-zero fixed vector is a supersolution of the same total mass, hence a solution; normalizing gives a probability.

decls.name: IsInvProb.pos_of_bstep
decls.statement: theorem IsInvProb.pos_of_bstep {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {x y : V} (hs : B.BStep x y) (hx : 0 < lam x) : 0 < lam y
decls.doc: Mass travels along a positive transition of the backward chain.

decls.name: IsInvProb.pos_of_breach
decls.statement: theorem IsInvProb.pos_of_breach {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {x y : V} (hr : B.BReach x y) (hx : 0 < lam x) : 0 < lam y
decls.doc: Mass travels along a walk of the backward chain.

decls.name: IsInvProb.exists_pos
decls.statement: theorem IsInvProb.exists_pos {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) : ∃ x, 0 < lam x
decls.doc: A probability charges some state.

decls.name: IsInvProb.pos
decls.statement: theorem IsInvProb.pos (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (y : V) : 0 < lam y
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(1)*, positivity.** An invariant probability of an irreducible chain is positive at every state.

decls.name: eq_zero_of_breach
decls.statement: theorem eq_zero_of_breach {nu : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ nu x) (hinv : ∀ y, ∑ x, nu x * B.phat x y = nu y) {x0 : V} (h0 : nu x0 = 0) {x : V} (hr : B.BReach x x0) : nu x = 0
decls.doc: A non-negative invariant vector that vanishes at `x₀` vanishes at every state that reaches `x₀`: invariance at a state where it vanishes forces it to vanish at every state carrying a positive transition into that state.

decls.name: invProb_unique
decls.statement: theorem invProb_unique (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam lam' : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (h' : B.IsInvProb lam') : lam = lam'
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(1)*, uniqueness.** The ratio maximum principle: if `λ` and `λ'` are invariant probabilities and `t` minimizes `λ/λ'`, then `ν = λ − tλ'` is non-negative, invariant and vanishes at the minimizer, hence everywhere; both being probabilities gives `t = 1`.

decls.name: IsInvProb.lam_snk_eq_src
decls.statement: theorem IsInvProb.lam_snk_eq_src {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) : lam G.snk = lam G.src
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(1)*, `λ(s₀) = λ(s_f)`.** The wrap edge is the only edge out of `s_f` in `Ĝ`, so the only backward transition into `s_f` is from `s₀`, and it has probability `1`: stationarity at `s_f` reads `λ(s_f) = λ(s₀) π̂_←(s₀ → s_f) = λ(s₀)`.

decls.name: universality_graphs_one
decls.statement: theorem universality_graphs_one (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) : (∀ x y : V, B.BReach x y) ∧ (∃ lam : V → ℝ, B.IsInvProb lam) ∧ (∀ lam lam' : V → ℝ, B.IsInvProb lam → B.IsInvProb lam' → lam = lam') ∧ (∀ lam : V → ℝ, B.IsInvProb lam → (∀ x, 0 < lam x) ∧ lam G.snk = lam G.src)
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(1)*** (`proofs.tex:967–969`, proof `proofs.tex:985`).

files.title: The frozen-backward family: the balanced ray, and the flow left by cutting the wrap edge

decls.name: internal
decls.statement: def internal : Finset V
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(3)*, the internal state space** `𝒮 := 𝒱 ∖ {s₀, s_f}` (`proofs.tex:1003`), as a `Finset` of `V`.

decls.name: mem_internal
decls.statement: theorem mem_internal {v : V} : v ∈ G.internal ↔ v ≠ G.src ∧ v ≠ G.snk
decls.doc: Membership in `𝒮`: the internal states are the vertices that are neither mark.

decls.name: internal_eq_erase_src
decls.statement: theorem internal_eq_erase_src : G.internal = (Finset.univ.erase G.snk).erase G.src
decls.doc: The two erasures commute.

decls.name: isInvProb_normalized
decls.statement: theorem isInvProb_normalized {f : V → ℝ} (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hpos : 0 < ∑ z, f z) (hinv : ∀ y, ∑ x, f x * B.phat x y = f y) : B.IsInvProb (fun x => f x / ∑ z, f z)
decls.doc: Normalizing a non-negative invariant vector of positive total mass gives an invariant probability of the backward chain.

decls.name: eq_smul_invProb
decls.statement: theorem eq_smul_invProb (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam f : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hne : f ≠ 0) (hinv : ∀ y, ∑ x, f x * B.phat x y = f y) : 0 < ∑ z, f z ∧ ∀ x, f x = (∑ z, f z) * lam x
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(2)*, un-normalized uniqueness.** A non-negative, non-zero vector invariant under the backward chain is `c λ` with `c = ∑ f > 0` — the step the paper takes in the words "whence `f_out μ = c λ` for some `c > 0` by *(1)*", where *(1)* delivers uniqueness only among *probabilities*.

decls.name: FrozenBalance
decls.statement: def FrozenBalance (pf : V → V → ℝ) (fout : V → ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(2)*, the family `Θ_{π_←}`** (`proofs.tex:970–974`), in the coordinates its proof uses (`proofs.tex:987`): the pair `(π_→, f_out)` satisfies `(f_out μ) ⊗ π_→ = π̂_← ⊗ (f_out μ)` iff `f_out(u) π_→(u → v) = π̂_←(v → u) f_out(v)` at every transition `u → v`.

decls.name: reversal
decls.statement: noncomputable def reversal (lam : V → ℝ) (u v : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(2)*, the `λ`-reversal `π̂_←^λ`** (`proofs.tex:974`): `π_→(s → s') = λ(s') π̂_←(s' → s) / λ(s)`, the elementary finite-space form of the disintegration of Lemma `lem:adjoint`.

decls.name: reversal_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem reversal_nonneg {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) (u v : V) : 0 ≤ B.reversal lam u v
decls.doc: The `λ`-reversal is non-negative.

decls.name: sum_reversal
decls.statement: theorem sum_reversal {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {u : V} (hu : lam u ≠ 0) : ∑ v, B.reversal lam u v = 1
decls.doc: The `λ`-reversal is a Markov kernel: its rows sum to `1`, by stationarity of `λ`.

decls.name: frozenBalance_reversal
decls.statement: theorem frozenBalance_reversal {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) (c : ℝ) : B.FrozenBalance (B.reversal lam) (fun x => c * lam x)
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(2)*, the converse inclusion** (`proofs.tex:991`, "Conversely this pair satisfies the constraint by definition of the reversal"): every point `c λ`, `c` real, of the ray lies in `Θ_{π_←}` with the `λ`-reversal as forward policy.

decls.name: frozenBalance_eq
decls.statement: theorem frozenBalance_eq (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {pf : V → V → ℝ} {fout : V → ℝ} (hrow : ∀ u, ∑ v, pf u v = 1) (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ fout x) (hne : fout ≠ 0) (hfb : B.FrozenBalance pf fout) : 0 < ∑ z, fout z ∧ (∀ x, fout x = (∑ z, fout z) * lam x) ∧ pf = B.reversal lam
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(2)*, the forward inclusion** (`proofs.tex:987–991`): a member of `Θ_{π_←}` with a non-zero non-negative outflow has `f_out = c λ` with `c = ∑ f_out > 0`, and its forward policy is the `λ`-reversal at **every** transition — `f_out` being positive everywhere, the disintegration is pinned everywhere.

decls.name: universality_graphs_two
decls.statement: theorem universality_graphs_two (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) : (∀ (pf : V → V → ℝ) (fout : V → ℝ), (∀ u, ∑ v, pf u v = 1) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ fout x) → fout ≠ 0 → B.FrozenBalance pf fout → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ (∀ x, fout x = c * lam x) ∧ pf = B.reversal lam) ∧ (∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → B.FrozenBalance (B.reversal lam) (fun x => c * lam x)) ∧ (∀ u v, 0 ≤ B.reversal lam u v) ∧ (∀ u, ∑ v, B.reversal lam u v = 1)
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(2)*** (`proofs.tex:970–974`, proof `proofs.tex:987–991`), in one statement: apart from `f_out ≡ 0`, the frozen-backward family on the loop closure is exactly the ray `f_out = c λ`, `c > 0`, carrying the `λ`-reversal — and the `λ`-reversal is a genuine Markov kernel.

decls.name: edgeFlow
decls.statement: noncomputable def edgeFlow (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (u v : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(3)*, the edge flow** (`proofs.tex:993`): `e(u → v) := c λ(v) π̂_←(v → u)`, the edge measure of the flow of item *(2)*.

decls.name: initFlow
decls.statement: noncomputable def initFlow (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (v : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(3)*, the initial flow**: `F_init(v) = e(s₀ → v)`.

decls.name: termFlow
decls.statement: noncomputable def termFlow (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (x : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(3)*, the terminal flow**: `F_term(x) = e(x → s_f)`.

decls.name: outflowStar
decls.statement: noncomputable def outflowStar (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (u : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(3)*, the star outflow**: `f_out^*(u) = c λ(u) − e(u → s_f)` (`proofs.tex:1003`).

decls.name: fwdStar
decls.statement: noncomputable def fwdStar (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (u v : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(3)*, the star forward policy**: `π_→^*(u → v) := e(u → v)/f_out^*(u)` (`proofs.tex:1003`).

decls.name: fmDefect
decls.statement: noncomputable def fmDefect (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (v : V) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`equ:FM_const` on `𝒮`, as a defect**: the two sides of the flow-matching constraint `F_init + (f_out^* μ) π_→^* = F_term + f_out^*`, subtracted.

decls.name: phat_snk_of_ne_src
decls.statement: theorem phat_snk_of_ne_src {v : V} (hv : v ≠ G.src) : B.phat v G.snk = 0
decls.doc: The only backward transition into `s_f` is from `s₀`: `π̂_←(v → s_f) = 0` for `v ≠ s₀`, because `s_f` has no outgoing edge in `G`.

decls.name: edgeFlow_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem edgeFlow_nonneg {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lam x) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (u v : V) : 0 ≤ B.edgeFlow lam c u v
decls.doc: The edge flow is non-negative.

decls.name: sum_edgeFlow_out
decls.statement: theorem sum_edgeFlow_out {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (c : ℝ) (u : V) : ∑ v, B.edgeFlow lam c u v = c * lam u
decls.doc: **`e` is a circulation, outgoing half** (`proofs.tex:995`): `∑_v e(u → v) = c λ(u)`, by stationarity of `λ`.

decls.name: sum_edgeFlow_in
decls.statement: theorem sum_edgeFlow_in (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (v : V) : ∑ u, B.edgeFlow lam c u v = c * lam v
decls.doc: **`e` is a circulation, incoming half** (`proofs.tex:996`): `∑_u e(u → v) = c λ(v)`, because `π̂_←(v → ·)` is a probability.

decls.name: edgeFlow_wrap
decls.statement: theorem edgeFlow_wrap (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : B.edgeFlow lam c G.snk G.src = c * lam G.src
decls.doc: **The wrap edge carries `c λ(s₀)`** (`proofs.tex:998`): `e(s_f → s₀) = c λ(s₀) π̂_←(s₀ → s_f) = c λ(s₀)`, which is `Z` at `c = Z/λ(s₀)`.

decls.name: edgeFlow_snk_out
decls.statement: theorem edgeFlow_snk_out (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) {v : V} (hv : v ≠ G.src) : B.edgeFlow lam c G.snk v = 0
decls.doc: Off the wrap edge, `s_f` emits nothing: `e(s_f → v) = 0` for `v ≠ s₀`.

decls.name: edgeFlow_to_src
decls.statement: theorem edgeFlow_to_src (lam : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) {u : V} (hu : u ≠ G.snk) : B.edgeFlow lam c u G.src = 0
decls.doc: Nothing but the wrap edge enters `s₀`: `e(u → s₀) = 0` for `u ≠ s_f`.

decls.name: outflowStar_eq_sum
decls.statement: theorem outflowStar_eq_sum {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (c : ℝ) (u : V) : B.outflowStar lam c u = ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.erase G.snk, B.edgeFlow lam c u v
decls.doc: **The star outflow is the flow out of `u` along every edge but the terminating one**: `f_out^*(u) = ∑_{v ≠ s_f} e(u → v)`.

decls.name: outflowStar_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem outflowStar_nonneg {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (u : V) : 0 ≤ B.outflowStar lam c u
decls.doc: **`f_out^* ≥ 0`**: a sum of non-negative edge flows.

decls.name: edgeFlow_eq_zero_of_outflowStar
decls.statement: theorem edgeFlow_eq_zero_of_outflowStar {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) {u : V} (hu : B.outflowStar lam c u = 0) {v : V} (hv : v ≠ G.snk) : B.edgeFlow lam c u v = 0
decls.doc: **Where the star outflow vanishes, no non-terminating edge carries flow.** This is the content of the paper's parenthesis "at states where `f_out^*` vanishes the trajectory terminates almost surely and the policy is immaterial".

decls.name: outflowStar_mul_fwdStar
decls.statement: theorem outflowStar_mul_fwdStar {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (u : V) {v : V} (hv : v ≠ G.snk) : B.outflowStar lam c u * B.fwdStar lam c u v = B.edgeFlow lam c u v
decls.doc: **`f_out^*(u) π_→^*(u → v) = e(u → v)`** (`proofs.tex:1003`) at every `u` and every `v ≠ s_f` — including the states where `f_out^*(u) = 0` and the quotient defining `π_→^*` is Lean's junk value, since there both sides are `0`.

decls.name: sum_fwdStar
decls.statement: theorem sum_fwdStar {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (c : ℝ) {u : V} (hu : B.outflowStar lam c u ≠ 0) : ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.erase G.snk, B.fwdStar lam c u v = 1
decls.doc: Where the star outflow does not vanish, `π_→^*(u → ·)` is a probability on `𝒱 ∖ {s_f}`.

decls.name: sum_fwdStar_internal
decls.statement: theorem sum_fwdStar_internal {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (c : ℝ) {u : V} (husnk : u ≠ G.snk) (hu : B.outflowStar lam c u ≠ 0) : ∑ v ∈ G.internal, B.fwdStar lam c u v = 1
decls.doc: **`π_→^*` is a Markov kernel on `𝒮`** where the star outflow does not vanish: nothing leaves an internal state towards `s₀`, so the row already summing to `1` over `𝒱 ∖ {s_f}` sums to `1` over `𝒮`.

decls.name: sum_initFlow
decls.statement: theorem sum_initFlow {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) (c : ℝ) : ∑ v, B.initFlow lam c v = c * lam G.src
decls.doc: **The initial flow has total mass `c λ(s₀)`** (`proofs.tex:998`), which is `Z` at `c = Z/λ(s₀)`.

decls.name: termFlow_eq_target
decls.statement: theorem termFlow_eq_target {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {c Z : ℝ} (hcZ : c * lam G.src = Z) (x : V) : B.termFlow lam c x = Z * B.pb G.snk x
decls.doc: **`F_term = κ := Z π_←(s_f → ·)`** (`proofs.tex:999–1003`), using `λ(s_f) = λ(s₀)`.

decls.name: termFlow_pos_of_edge
decls.statement: theorem termFlow_pos_of_edge (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (hlam : ∀ x, 0 < lam x) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {x : V} (hx : G.Edge x G.snk) : 0 < B.termFlow lam c x
decls.doc: **`κ` is positive on every terminating state** (`proofs.tex:1003`): `π_←` is positive on every edge `x → s_f`.

decls.name: fmDefect_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem fmDefect_eq_zero {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ G.internal) : B.fmDefect lam c v = 0
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(3)*, flow matching, exactly** (`proofs.tex:1004–1009`): at every internal state the defect of `equ:FM_const` is `0`.

decls.name: flow_matching
decls.statement: theorem flow_matching {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ G.internal) : B.initFlow lam c v + (∑ u ∈ G.internal, B.outflowStar lam c u * B.fwdStar lam c u v) = B.termFlow lam c v + B.outflowStar lam c v
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(3)*, flow matching**, in the paper's own form (`proofs.tex:1004–1009`): `F_init(v) + ((f_out^* μ) π_→^*)(v) = F_term(v) + f_out^*(v)` at every `v ∈ 𝒮`.

decls.name: residuals_eq_zero
decls.statement: theorem residuals_eq_zero {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ G.internal) : (B.fmDefect lam c v)⁻ = 0 ∧ (B.fmDefect lam c v)⁺ = 0
decls.doc: **The residuals vanish** (`proofs.tex:981`, "all residuals `δF_init`, `δF_term` are zero").

decls.name: universality_graphs_three
decls.statement: theorem universality_graphs_three (hpc : G.PathConnected) (hbpos : B.PositiveOnEdges) {lam : V → ℝ} (h : B.IsInvProb lam) {Z c : ℝ} (hZ : 0 < Z) (hc : c = Z / lam G.src) : 0 < c ∧ c * lam G.src = Z ∧ B.edgeFlow lam c G.snk G.src = Z ∧ (∑ v, B.initFlow lam c v) = Z ∧ (∀ x, B.termFlow lam c x = Z * B.pb G.snk x) ∧ (∀ x, G.Edge x G.snk → 0 < B.termFlow lam c x) ∧ (∀ u, 0 ≤ B.outflowStar lam c u) ∧ (∀ v ∈ G.internal, B.fmDefect lam c v = 0)
decls.doc: **`theo:universality_graphs`*(3)*** (`proofs.tex:975–979`, proof `proofs.tex:993–1009`), in one statement.

files.title: Appendix B: the shared vocabulary

decls.name: tv
decls.statement: noncomputable def tv {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (p q : X → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: Total variation on a finite set, with the ½-convention: `TV(p,q) = ½ ∑_x |p(x) − q(x)|`.

decls.name: chiSq
decls.statement: noncomputable def chiSq {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (q p : X → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: The `χ²`-divergence in its standard finite form, `χ²(q‖p) = ∑_x (q(x) − p(x))²/p(x)`.

decls.name: unif
decls.statement: noncomputable def unif (X : Type*) [Fintype X] : X → ℝ
decls.doc: The uniform law `q_{E,T}` on a finite set.

decls.name: logRatio
decls.statement: noncomputable def logRatio {X T : Type*} (π : X → ℝ) (pB : X → T → ℝ) (pF : T → ℝ) (x : X) (t : T) : ℝ
decls.doc: The log-ratio `ℓ(τ) = log (p_F(τ) / (π(x) p_B(τ|x)))` of the proof at `silva_comparison.tex:89`.

decls.name: residual
decls.statement: noncomputable def residual {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] (pET π : X → ℝ) (pB : X → T → ℝ) (pF : T → ℝ) : ℝ
decls.doc: The residual `𝓔(p_F) = E_{x∼p_{E,T}} E_{τ∼p_B(·|x)}[(log(p_F(τ)/(π(x) p_B(τ|x))))²]` of `silva_comparison.tex:24–26`.

decls.name: residual_eq
decls.statement: theorem residual_eq {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] (pET π : X → ℝ) (pB : X → T → ℝ) (pF : T → ℝ) : residual pET π pB pF = ∑ x, pET x * ∑ t, pB x t * Real.log (pF t / (π x * pB x t)) ^ 2
decls.doc: `residual` with the log written out, for rewriting.

decls.name: MprimeLe
decls.statement: def MprimeLe {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] (pB : X → T → ℝ) (pF : T → ℝ) (π : X → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Prop
decls.doc: `M' ≤ c`, with `M' = max(M, ‖π‖_∞)` and `M = max{p_F(τ)/p_B(τ|x) : p_B(τ|x) > 0}` (`silva_comparison.tex:32`), unfolded into its two halves.

decls.name: chiSq_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem chiSq_nonneg {X : Type*} [Fintype X] {q p : X → ℝ} (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x) : 0 ≤ chiSq q p
decls.doc: `χ²(q‖p) ≥ 0` whenever `p ≥ 0`: the factor `1 + χ²` under the square root is nonnegative, which is what lets the final Cauchy–Schwarz step be multiplied through.

decls.name: chiSq_self
decls.statement: theorem chiSq_self {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (p : X → ℝ) : chiSq p p = 0
decls.doc: `χ²(p‖p) = 0`: the training law that *is* the uniform one has no `χ²` term.

decls.name: sum_unif
decls.statement: theorem sum_unif {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (h : (Fintype.card X : ℝ) ≠ 0) : ∑ x, unif X x = 1
decls.doc: The uniform law is a probability law on a nonempty finite set.

decls.name: sum_sq_div_eq_one_add_chiSq
decls.statement: theorem sum_sq_div_eq_one_add_chiSq {X : Type*} [Fintype X] {q p : X → ℝ} (hp : ∀ x, 0 < p x) (hq1 : ∑ x, q x = 1) (hp1 : ∑ x, p x = 1) : ∑ x, q x ^ 2 / p x = 1 + chiSq q p
decls.doc: `∑_x q(x)²/p(x) = 1 + χ²(q‖p)`, the identity the factor `1 + χ²` of `eq:silva_bound` stands for.

decls.name: wSupport
decls.statement: noncomputable def wSupport {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] (pB : X → T → ℝ) : Finset (X × T)
decls.doc: The pairs `(x,τ)` over which `w_min` is a minimum: those with `p_B(τ|x) > 0`.

decls.name: wMin
decls.statement: noncomputable def wMin {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] (pET : X → ℝ) (pB : X → T → ℝ) (h : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) : ℝ
decls.doc: **`w_min := min{ p_{E,T}(x) p_B(τ|x) : p_B(τ|x) > 0 }`** of `prop:silva_no_uniform`.

decls.name: wMin_le
decls.statement: theorem wMin_le {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] {pET : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} (h : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) {x : X} {t : T} (ht : 0 < pB x t) : wMin pET pB h ≤ pET x * pB x t

decls.name: wMin_pos
decls.statement: theorem wMin_pos {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] {pET : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} (h : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hET : ∀ x, 0 < pET x) : 0 < wMin pET pB h

files.title: The Silva et al. total-variation bound, with the constant written out

decls.name: sq_sub_weighted_le
decls.statement: theorem sq_sub_weighted_le {T : Type*} [Fintype T] {w f : T → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hw : ∀ τ, 0 ≤ w τ) (hw1 : ∑ τ, w τ = 1) : (c - ∑ τ, w τ * f τ) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ τ, w τ * (c - f τ) ^ 2
decls.doc: For a probability weight `w` on a finite set, `(c − ∑ w f)² ≤ ∑ w (c − f)²`.

decls.name: logLipschitz
decls.statement: theorem logLipschitz {a b C : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (haC : a ≤ C) (hbC : b ≤ C) : |a - b| ≤ C * |Real.log a - Real.log b|
decls.doc: `|a − b| ≤ C |log a − log b|` for `0 < a ≤ C` and `0 < b ≤ C`.

decls.name: sq_sub_le_sq_mul_log_sq
decls.statement: theorem sq_sub_le_sq_mul_log_sq {a b C : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (haC : a ≤ C) (hbC : b ≤ C) : (a - b) ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 * Real.log (a / b) ^ 2
decls.doc: The squared form used in the proof: `(a − b)² ≤ C² (log(a/b))²` for `0 < a ≤ C`, `0 < b ≤ C`.

decls.name: tv_le_sqrt_residual
decls.statement: theorem tv_le_sqrt_residual {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] {pET π pT : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} {pF : T → ℝ} {M Pinf : ℝ} (hET_pos : ∀ x, 0 < pET x) (hET_sum : ∑ x, pET x = 1) (hπ_pos : ∀ x, 0 < π x) (hB_nonneg : ∀ x τ, 0 ≤ pB x τ) (hB_sum : ∀ x, ∑ τ, pB x τ = 1) (hF_pos : ∀ x τ, 0 < pB x τ → 0 < pF τ) (hdom : ∀ x, pT x = ∑ τ, pB x τ * (pF τ / pB x τ)) (hM : ∀ x τ, 0 < pB x τ → pF τ / pB x τ ≤ M) (hPinf : ∀ x, π x ≤ Pinf) : tv pT π ≤ (Fintype.card X : ℝ) / 2 * max M Pinf * Real.sqrt ((1 + chiSq (unif X) pET) * residual pET π pB pF)
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_explicit`** (`silva_comparison.tex:29–39`), with `M` and `‖π‖_∞` presented as upper bounds: if `p_{E,T}` and `π` have full support, `p_B(·|x)` is a probability law dominating the forward trajectories into `x` (`hdom`), `p_F` is positive on the support of `p_B`, and `p_F(τ)/p_B(τ|x) ≤ M`, `π ≤ Pinf`, then `TV(p_T, π) ≤ (|𝒳|/2) · max(M, Pinf) · sqrt((1 + χ²(q_{E,T}‖p_{E,T})) · 𝓔(p_F))`.

decls.name: tv_le_sqrt_residual_max
decls.statement: theorem tv_le_sqrt_residual_max {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T] {pET π pT : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} {pF : T → ℝ} (hX : (Finset.univ : Finset X).Nonempty) (hsupp : ((Finset.univ : Finset (X × T)).filter fun p => 0 < pB p.1 p.2).Nonempty) (hET_pos : ∀ x, 0 < pET x) (hET_sum : ∑ x, pET x = 1) (hπ_pos : ∀ x, 0 < π x) (hB_nonneg : ∀ x τ, 0 ≤ pB x τ) (hB_sum : ∀ x, ∑ τ, pB x τ = 1) (hF_pos : ∀ x τ, 0 < pB x τ → 0 < pF τ) (hdom : ∀ x, pT x = ∑ τ, pB x τ * (pF τ / pB x τ)) : tv pT π ≤ (Fintype.card X : ℝ) / 2 * max (((Finset.univ : Finset (X × T)).filter fun p => 0 < pB p.1 p.2).sup' hsupp fun p => pF p.2 / pB p.1 p.2) ((Finset.univ : Finset X).sup' hX π) * Real.sqrt ((1 + chiSq (unif X) pET) * residual pET π pB pF)
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_explicit` with the paper's own constants**: `M` is the maximum of `p_F(τ)/p_B(τ|x)` over the support of `p_B`, and `‖π‖_∞` the maximum of `π`.

files.title: The state-space dependence of the Silva bound is unavoidable

decls.name: abs_exp_sub_one_le
decls.statement: theorem abs_exp_sub_one_le {u s : ℝ} (h : |u| ≤ s) : |Real.exp u - 1| ≤ Real.exp s - 1
decls.doc: If `|u| ≤ s` then `|e^u − 1| ≤ e^s − 1`: the upper half is monotonicity of `exp`, the lower half is `1 − e^{−s} ≤ s ≤ e^s − 1`.

decls.name: tv_le_exp_sqrt_energy
decls.statement: theorem tv_le_exp_sqrt_energy {pET : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} {pF : T → ℝ} {π pT : X → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hπ : ∀ x, 0 < π x) (hπ1 : ∑ x, π x = 1) (hET : ∀ x, 0 ≤ pET x) (hB : ∀ x t, 0 ≤ pB x t) (hB1 : ∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) (hF : ∀ x t, 0 < pB x t → 0 < pF t) (hdom : ∀ x, pT x = ∑ t, pB x t * (pF t / pB x t)) (hw : 0 < w) (hwle : ∀ x t, 0 < pB x t → w ≤ pET x * pB x t) : tv pT π ≤ 2⁻¹ * (Real.exp (Real.sqrt (residual pET π pB pF / w)) - 1)
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_no_uniform`(i)**, in the form its proof uses: with `w` any positive lower bound for `p_{E,T}(x) p_B(τ|x)` on the support of `p_B`, `TV(p_T,π) ≤ ½ (e^{√(𝓔(p_F)/w)} − 1)`.

decls.name: tv_le_exp_sqrt_energy_wmin
decls.statement: theorem tv_le_exp_sqrt_energy_wmin {pET : X → ℝ} {pB : X → T → ℝ} {pF : T → ℝ} {π pT : X → ℝ} (h : (wSupport pB).Nonempty) (hπ : ∀ x, 0 < π x) (hπ1 : ∑ x, π x = 1) (hET : ∀ x, 0 < pET x) (hB : ∀ x t, 0 ≤ pB x t) (hB1 : ∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) (hF : ∀ x t, 0 < pB x t → 0 < pF t) (hdom : ∀ x, pT x = ∑ t, pB x t * (pF t / pB x t)) : tv pT π ≤ 2⁻¹ * (Real.exp (Real.sqrt (residual pET π pB pF / wMin pET pB h)) - 1)
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_no_uniform`(i)** with the paper's own constant `w_min`.

decls.name: deltaPB
decls.statement: def deltaPB (X : Type*) [DecidableEq X] : X → X → ℝ
decls.doc: The backward kernel of a graph in which each terminal `x` has one incoming trajectory, identified with `x` itself: `p_B(τ|x) = 1` for `τ = x` and `0` otherwise.

decls.name: deltaPB_nonneg
decls.statement: theorem deltaPB_nonneg (x t : X) : 0 ≤ deltaPB X x t

decls.name: deltaPB_pos_iff
decls.statement: theorem deltaPB_pos_iff {x t : X} : 0 < deltaPB X x t ↔ t = x

decls.name: deltaPB_sum
decls.statement: theorem deltaPB_sum (x : X) : ∑ t, deltaPB X x t = 1

decls.name: hdom_deltaPB
decls.statement: theorem hdom_deltaPB (pF : X → ℝ) (x : X) : pF x = ∑ t, deltaPB X x t * (pF t / deltaPB X x t)
decls.doc: The domination identity holds for the one-parent kernel, with `p_T = p_F`.

decls.name: energy_deltaPB
decls.statement: theorem energy_deltaPB (pET pF π : X → ℝ) : residual pET π (deltaPB X) pF = ∑ x, pET x * Real.log (pF x / π x) ^ 2
decls.doc: `𝓔(p_F)` for the one-parent kernel: one term per terminal state.

decls.name: Star
decls.statement: abbrev Star (K : ℕ)
decls.doc: The terminal states of the star DAG: `x* = inl false`, `x' = inl true`, and the `K` filler states `b₁,…,b_K = inr i`.

decls.name: starPi
decls.statement: noncomputable def starPi (K : ℕ) : Star K → ℝ
decls.doc: The target `π` of the star witness: `π(x*) = π(x') = ¼`, `π(bᵢ) = 1/(2K)`.

decls.name: starPF
decls.statement: noncomputable def starPF (K : ℕ) : Star K → ℝ
decls.doc: The forward policy of the star witness: `p_F(s_o→x*) = ⅜`, `p_F(s_o→x') = ⅛`, `p_F(s_o→bᵢ) = 1/(2K)`.

decls.name: starPET
decls.statement: noncomputable def starPET (K : ℕ) : Star K → ℝ
decls.doc: The uniform training distribution on the `K+2` terminals.

decls.name: card_star
decls.statement: theorem card_star (K : ℕ) : (Fintype.card (Star K) : ℝ) = (K : ℝ) + 2

decls.name: starPET_pos
decls.statement: theorem starPET_pos (K : ℕ) (x : Star K) : 0 < starPET K x

decls.name: starPET_sum
decls.statement: theorem starPET_sum (K : ℕ) : ∑ x, starPET K x = 1

decls.name: star_chiSq
decls.statement: theorem star_chiSq (K : ℕ) : chiSq (unif (Star K)) (starPET K) = 0
decls.doc: `χ²(q_{E,T}‖p_{E,T}) = 0`: the training distribution *is* the uniform one.

decls.name: star_tv
decls.statement: theorem star_tv (K : ℕ) : tv (starPF K) (starPi K) = 1 / 8
decls.doc: **`TV(p_T,π) = ⅛`** for the star witness, for every `K`.

decls.name: starK_pos
decls.statement: theorem starK_pos : (0 : ℝ) < K

decls.name: starK_one
decls.statement: theorem starK_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ K

decls.name: starPi_pos
decls.statement: theorem starPi_pos (x : Star K) : 0 < starPi K x

decls.name: starPF_pos
decls.statement: theorem starPF_pos (x : Star K) : 0 < starPF K x

decls.name: starPi_sum
decls.statement: theorem starPi_sum : ∑ x, starPi K x = 1

decls.name: starPF_sum
decls.statement: theorem starPF_sum : ∑ x, starPF K x = 1

decls.name: star_Mprime
decls.statement: theorem star_Mprime : MprimeLe (deltaPB (Star K)) (starPF K) (starPi K) 1
decls.doc: **`M' ≤ 1`** for the star witness.

decls.name: star_energy
decls.statement: theorem star_energy : residual (starPET K) (starPi K) (deltaPB (Star K)) (starPF K) = ((Real.log (3 / 2)) ^ 2 + (Real.log 2) ^ 2) / ((K : ℝ) + 2)
decls.doc: **`𝓔(p_F) = ((log 3/2)² + (log 2)²)/(K+2)`** for the star witness: the log-ratios vanish on the `bᵢ`.

decls.name: log_sq_sum_le_one
decls.statement: theorem log_sq_sum_le_one : (Real.log (3 / 2)) ^ 2 + (Real.log 2) ^ 2 ≤ 1
decls.doc: `(log 3/2)² + (log 2)² ≤ 1`: `log(3/2) ≤ 1/2` because `log x ≤ x − 1`, and `log 2 < 0.6931471808` by `Real.log_two_lt_d9`; the sum of squares is at most `0.7305`.

decls.name: exists_star_witness
decls.statement: theorem exists_star_witness {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (∀ x, 0 < starPi K x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 < starPF K x) ∧ (∑ x, starPi K x = 1) ∧ (∑ x, starPF K x = 1) ∧ (∀ x, 0 < starPET K x) ∧ (∑ x, starPET K x = 1) ∧ chiSq (unif (Star K)) (starPET K) = 0 ∧ MprimeLe (deltaPB (Star K)) (starPF K) (starPi K) 1 ∧ 0 < residual (starPET K) (starPi K) (deltaPB (Star K)) (starPF K) ∧ residual (starPET K) (starPi K) (deltaPB (Star K)) (starPF K) ≤ ε ∧ tv (starPF K) (starPi K) = 1 / 8
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_no_uniform`(ii)**: for every `ε > 0` the star witness with `K` large has `χ² = 0`, `M' ≤ 1`, `𝓔(p_F) ≤ ε` and `TV(p_T,π) = ⅛`.

decls.name: no_state_space_free_bound
decls.statement: theorem no_state_space_free_bound : ¬ ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto F (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ (X T : Type) [Fintype X] [Fintype T] (pET : X → ℝ) (pB : X → T → ℝ) (pF : T → ℝ) (π pT : X → ℝ), (∀ x, 0 < π x) → (∑ x, π x = 1) → (∀ x, 0 < pET x) → (∑ x, pET x = 1) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ pB x t) → (∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) → (∀ x t, 0 < pB x t → 0 < pF t) → (∀ x, pT x = ∑ t, pB x t * (pF t / pB x t)) → chiSq (unif X) pET = 0 → MprimeLe pB pF π 1 → tv pT π ≤ F (residual pET π pB pF)
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_no_uniform`, the "in particular"**: no function of the residual alone, vanishing as the residual vanishes, bounds the total variation over all finite instances with `χ²(q_{E,T}‖p_{E,T}) = 0` and `M' ≤ 1`.

decls.name: no_three_argument_bound
decls.statement: theorem no_three_argument_bound : ¬ ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto (fun e => F e 0 1) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ (X T : Type) [Fintype X] [Fintype T] (pET : X → ℝ) (pB : X → T → ℝ) (pF : T → ℝ) (π pT : X → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ x, 0 < π x) → (∑ x, π x = 1) → (∀ x, 0 < pET x) → (∑ x, pET x = 1) → (∀ x t, 0 ≤ pB x t) → (∀ x, ∑ t, pB x t = 1) → (∀ x t, 0 < pB x t → 0 < pF t) → (∀ x, pT x = ∑ t, pB x t * (pF t / pB x t)) → MprimeLe pB pF π c → tv pT π ≤ F (residual pET π pB pF) (chiSq (unif X) pET) c
decls.doc: **`prop:silva_no_uniform`, the "in particular" in the paper's three-argument form**: no `F(𝓔, χ², M')` with `F(·,0,1) → 0` bounds `TV`, when `F`'s third slot may be fed any bound on `M'`.
